report:
Missing a row during snapshot in oracle connector

Hi,
oracle-ee-19c
debezium 2.5.2 (oracle)
I was testing for oracle connector with many transactions...
Then, I found out a transaction which starts before snapshot and commits after snapshot didn't come to kafka topic.
this is an example of i experienced.
seq |      debezium                                |   user (sqlplus)--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1      |                                                       |   insert (1, 'a');
2     |   start debezium                           |

9     |                                                          |    commit;
10     |                                                        |  insert (2, 'b'); 11   |                                                          |  commit;
the (1, 'a') value didn't come to kafka topic.
but, (2, 'b') value come successfully

evidence.quote: In Oracle, you can enable a feature called Transaction Snapshot Boundary mode using \"internal.log.mining.transaction.snapshot.boundary.mode\"... skip... This is the default, and no in-progress transactions are captured."; reporter: "It worked.

notes: A transaction open before the snapshot and committed after is not captured by default (boundary mode=skip); looks like data loss but is intended, fixed by enabling the internal boundary mode.

reviews.fix: Set internal.log.mining.transaction.snapshot.boundary.mode so in-progress transactions at snapshot time are captured; default behavior skips them by design.
reviews.evidence: Chris Cranford: "you can enable a feature called Transaction Snapshot Boundary mode using internal.log.mining.transaction.snapshot.boundary.mode"; reporter: "It worked."
reviews.boundary: B vs D: the default skipping of in-progress transactions is deliberate and a connector setting changes it, so B.
